subject: Strategic Plan Mission and Vision Revisions
overview: The School Committee hosted roundtable discussions to gather public feedback on revising the Medford Public Schools strategic plan mission and vision statements. Groups representing different educational levels and special education reported priorities such as measurable benchmarks, equitable learning environments, and the availability of after-school programming.

items.title: Opening and Breakout Assignment
items.summary: Facilitators organized participants into elementary, middle, high school, special education, and language-specific breakout rooms to discuss three core questions regarding the district's mission and vision.

items.title: Special Education Report
items.summary: The group advocated for specific language regarding student diversity and the establishment of measurable benchmarks to track progress.

items.title: High School Report
items.summary: Participants suggested a draft mission statement emphasizing safety and resilience and discussed creating a concise catchphrase for the district.

items.title: Middle School Report
items.summary: The discussion focused on differentiating between mission and vision statements and ensuring the district's core values are explicitly included in the revised language.

items.title: Elementary School Report
items.summary: Key priorities identified included improving access to after-school care, fostering critical thinking, and ensuring the curriculum reflects diverse skills and backgrounds.

items.title: Conclusion and Future Sessions
items.summary: The Superintendent reported a lack of participation in the language-specific rooms and announced a second roundtable session to continue gathering community feedback.
